purpose: Post-failure diagnosis, not prospective hypothesis confirmation
targets: Three failed local g steps at cutoffs 20/24 A and three failed breathing energy mixed stencils at cutoff 16 A
method: Enumerate unlike-layer periodic pairs in a 0.005 A cutoff shell; retain actual membership at all stencil corners; evaluate fixed-normal KCz shifted energies and vertical forces independently
image_completeness: Derive integer bounds from inverse lateral lattice and coordinate extrema; include every image that can enter radius cutoff+0.005 A
membership_rule: r squared < cutoff squared, matching source
interpretation: Subtract crossing-pair contribution only to diagnose residual; never replace saved derivatives or reopen original gates
